title: Introduction to Online Work and Freelancing
description: For school leavers who want to start earning from skills they can sell online. You will learn how online work really works, set up a strong profile, win your first clients, get paid safely to Kenya and avoid the scams that target beginners.
outcomes: Explain the main kinds of online work and choose a skill to start with
Set up a professional freelancer profile and a simple portfolio
Write short, specific proposals that get replies
Price your work sensibly and choose a safe way to get paid in Kenya
Communicate clearly with clients and manage your time and deadlines
Spot and avoid common online job scams
